citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:18am on
7/22/2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee/registrant by Honked, knocked, called out loudly and
contacted facility representative on phone number provided.. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records
for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in
enforcement action.
End Section
